text: I am old, 73. A lawyer by myself. Bad experience with uploading. There were so many faults with the uploading system  etc. I pay in my our case for help. I saw another old couple age 70-80, that keep forgetting documents and gets into typical MH troubles. However, if you are younger and fluent with uploading - go ahead. Making uploading documents mistakes with MH is sometines fatal when you are old and keep forgetting issues.
